title: CORBA IDL: Use a tree stack instead of randomly named subtrees
description:
Instead of generating nonces for randomly named subtrees, use a
stack of trees. This way the dissectors don't randomly change
each time they are regenerated, which means that regeneration
could be done in CI similar to other generated dissectors.
